DATASETS.label: Projects
DATASETS.description: Every project with delivery and money metrics (progress, SPI, effort ratio, margin).

fields.label: Effort ratio
fields.description: Actual ÷ estimated hours; above 1.2 is flagged.

fields.label: SPI
fields.description: Schedule performance index: earned ÷ planned by today.

DATASETS.label: Milestones
DATASETS.description: Milestones with delivery state, slip and billing.

DATASETS.label: Tasks
DATASETS.description: Project and general tasks with owner, reviewer, dates, estimate vs actual, timeliness (early/on time/late), delay reason, quality rating and review rounds.

fields.label: Timeliness
fields.description: Completed tasks only: early (≥1 working day before due), on time, or late.

fields.label: Variance (working days)
fields.description: Completed tasks: working days after (+) or before (−) the due date.

fields.label: On-time rate
fields.description: Completed tasks: 100% if early or on time, 0% if late. Average it for on-time delivery %.

DATASETS.label: Hours (timesheets)
DATASETS.description: Every timesheet entry, costed at the rate valid on the day it was worked.

DATASETS.label: Allocations
DATASETS.description: Planned allocation of people to project milestones (percent of the day).

DATASETS.label: Invoices
DATASETS.description: Milestone invoices with payments and receivables ageing.

DATASETS.label: Ledger (income & costs)
DATASETS.description: Income and expense entries (recurring expanded monthly) plus payments received — the source of billed, collected and costs.

DATASETS.label: Deals (pipeline)
DATASETS.description: Sales opportunities with stage, value, weighted value and cycle.

fields.label: Win rate
fields.description: Won = 100%, lost = 0%, open deals excluded. Average it to get win rate.

DATASETS.label: Sales activities
DATASETS.description: Calls, meetings, demos and follow-ups logged against deals.

DATASETS.label: Payroll
DATASETS.description: Monthly pay per person: base, deductions for unapproved/LWP days, variable, net. Months without a run are estimated from CTC.

DATASETS.label: People
DATASETS.description: Team members with role, manager, load, delivery record and timesheet discipline.

DATASETS.label: Operations register
DATASETS.description: Recurring duties: payroll, statutory filings, finance and admin with due dates.

DATASETS.label: Task reviews
DATASETS.description: Every submission of a task for review: reviewer, decision (approved / sent back), reason, quality rating and whether it was submitted after the due date.

DATASETS.label: Leave requests
DATASETS.description: Leave applications with type, days, status and who decided. Employees see only their own; managers see their reports; HR sees everyone.

DATASETS.label: Expense claims
DATASETS.description: Expense claims (reimbursements) with category, amount, status, approver, budget check and payment. Employees see their own; PMs their projects and team; admin and HR everyone.

DATASETS.label: Purchase orders
DATASETS.description: Purchase orders to vendors with budget category, value (incl. GST), status and approval.

DATASETS.label: Vendor bills
DATASETS.description: Bills from vendors (payables) with GST, TDS, due date, status and payment.

DATASETS.label: Budget vs actual
DATASETS.description: Monthly budget against actual for every expense category (actual = ledger costs + approved claims and bills) and every revenue stream. Same numbers as Spend → Budgets.

fields.label: Variance
fields.description: Expense: budget − actual (negative = over). Revenue: actual − budget.

DATASETS.label: Revenue leakage
DATASETS.description: Revenue lost or at risk: lost deals, unbilled hours, bad-debt risk and rejected change requests (auto) plus discounts, write-offs, credit notes, penalties and churn (manual).

DATASETS.label: Appraisals
DATASETS.description: Appraisal reviews per cycle: self, manager and final rating, increment, on-time delivery and the system-suggested score. HR sees everyone; managers see their reports.

fields.label: System score
fields.description: Suggested rating from goals, task delivery, timesheets and behaviour (1–5).

DATASETS.label: Candidates
DATASETS.description: Recruitment pipeline: candidates per opening with source, stage, experience, expected CTC and days in the pipeline.

DATASETS.label: Documents
DATASETS.description: Project and company documents you can see: category, version, must-read status and acknowledgement counts (counts only where you manage the document).

DATASETS.label: OKR key results
DATASETS.description: Key results under company, team and personal objectives with current vs target, progress and status. Auto metrics are computed live; finance metrics are hidden without finance access.
